title: AI in Healthcare: Improving Access and Reducing Waste
summary: The use of AI in healthcare is improving access to medical resources, reducing waste, and enhancing patient care. However, concerns around data privacy and accuracy must be addressed. AI-powered systems are being used in various healthcare applications, including mental health support and medication redistribution.

contrasts.statement: While AI has the potential to improve healthcare, concerns around data privacy and accuracy must be addressed
